== Objectives ==
Search for more clues at Sorrowmore Lake on Balor.
* [[Stormreaver Cell Key]]

== Description ==
<The journal features dedicated listings of sightings, observations, shift schedules and oddities encountered during the few hours the corps was stationed on the plateau. Despite having seen several specters of past denizens, nothing purveyed anything related to the disappearances from Northwind. While smoke was seen emanating from the castle ruins across the ravines, no attempts for reconnaissance were made yet. Furthermore, it appears that a small force of Thrall's Horde has settled on one of the smaller islands. Whatever they are planning on this island remains a conundrum for now.

The last page of this book describes the preparation for investigating the abandoned inn at Sorrowmore Lake, just at the foot of this plateau. Perhaps you can find survivors there.>

==Rewards==
* 1850 XP

== Progress ==
Oh, what a relief to see another <race>! Please, you have to get me out of here! Their leader is on the top floors, a burly one, with an iron fist! She has the key; quickly, we don't have much time!

== Completion ==
The Light be praised for your rescue. I thought I would've ended like the rest of the corps. Thank you again, I'll tell you everything I know before getting out of this miserable place.
